# The same flow in the words of a VHS tape: what VHS has no word for
# (start, state, expect) is ours.
Set FontSize 16
Output demo.gif
start /home/evan
size 60 10
Hide
Show
Type "re"
Sleep 200ms
Screenshot typed
state current readme.md
Ctrl+U
Down
state current notes.md
Up
Enter
Sleep 1s
state dir /home/evan/projects
Type@50ms 'gl'
Tab
Backspace 6
Left
state dir /home/evan
Escape
Shift+Tab
Alt+Left
